delivered_files.role: Reusable Project, Feature, document, governance, Agent, audit and orchestration read-model service.
Transport-neutral NornBridge and human tracking contracts.
Single schema-oriented projection for canonical and legacy signed documents.
Versioned local API with stable envelopes and explicit governance actions.
Loopback-only authenticated HTTP and SSE server.
Debounced durable-file invalidation observer for live tracking.
Append-only human governance event model with portable actor snapshots.
Locked and atomic portable governance ledger persistence.
arka-norn web command, loopback launch and browser bootstrap.
Signed-document cover, contract facts, dependencies and progressive technical disclosure.
Shared editorial document hierarchy inspired by established Arka Deck reading patterns.
Official Arka Labs color, typography, surface and component tokens.
Official locally distributed Arka Labs mark.
Loopback security, EN/FR workflow, official brand, responsive overflow and Axe accessibility E2E evidence.
Public user and technical documentation for tracking, governance, security, documents and official identity.
Version 2.1.0, Web build and test scripts, runtime dependencies and packaged dist integration.

covered_requirements.requirement: Canonical governance contracts and reusable Project tracking projections.
covered_requirements.evidence: Governance domain, schema, filesystem store and application/web read models pass web-governance, web-document-renderer and the complete TypeScript test suite.

covered_requirements.requirement: Secure loopback application service and arka-norn web command.
covered_requirements.evidence: web-security unit tests and Playwright reject missing tokens and foreign origins; release verification validates the packaged CLI and server artifacts.

covered_requirements.requirement: Complete EN/FR Project manager Web experience using official Arka Labs identity.
covered_requirements.evidence: Playwright creates a profile, Project and Essential Feature, switches locale, verifies Poppins, the official mark and #c70f43, and finds no overflow at 1024, 1440 or 1920 pixels.

covered_requirements.requirement: Human governance and explicit operational actions without Agent control.
covered_requirements.evidence: Append-only reduction, profile snapshot and API tests pass; the orchestration mutation endpoint is absent and returns 404 in Playwright.

covered_requirements.requirement: Live orchestration observation and deterministic relationship graph.
covered_requirements.evidence: The watcher, SSE invalidation hub, read-only execution projection and lazy relationship graph are built and covered by integration and release suites.

covered_requirements.requirement: Distribution, English public documentation and complete release gates.
covered_requirements.evidence: npm run release:verify passes lint, language, max-lines, selftest, 60 E2E scenarios, coverage thresholds, CLI coverage, benchmark, dependency audit and npm pack dry-run; the tarball is 1.8 MB and includes dist/web.

covered_requirements.requirement: All signed framework productions are readable as human documents rather than raw JSON.
covered_requirements.evidence: The shared renderer presents a signed cover, semantic numbered sections, structured lists and records, resolved references, progressive provenance and optional raw JSON; dedicated Vitest and unit tests pass.

covered_requirements.requirement: Accessible, stable implementation with no maintained source file above 700 lines.
covered_requirements.evidence: Axe reports no serious or critical violation; typecheck, lint, check:max-lines, check:language, test:web and test:web:e2e all pass.
